flagged.evidence: The file cites Deligiannidis §§10.1 and 13.1. In §10.1 (PDF p. 58), the source lists acceptance under H1 and rejection under H0, then calls them “Type I/II error probabilities respectively.” With H0 as null and action 1 meaning reject, those are Type II then Type I; §10.1 reverses the labels and does not support the definition’s type-I/type-II naming. The Polyanskiy–Wu citation still supports the lower-boundary orientation.
